title: Tax Bracket Visualizer
description: See marginal tax per bracket as bars with fully user-editable brackets.
howto: Edit the brackets: each row sets the "up to" income and its marginal rate. Leave the last one empty for no cap.
Add or remove brackets to model any system.
Read the tax owed in each bracket as bars, plus total, effective, and marginal rates.

faqs.a: The rate applied only to income inside that bracket, not to your whole income. This visualizer shades exactly how much each bracket contributes.
The defaults are illustrative only and may not match any current tax code. Enter your own brackets for an accurate picture.

faqs.q: Why is my effective rate lower than my top rate?
faqs.a: Because lower brackets tax the first slices of income at lower rates. The effective rate is total tax divided by income.
